title: Gussa: how each mizaj gets angry
caption:
Every mizaj gets angry. They just do it very differently.

One flares up and forgives by the next cup of chai. One says the sharpest sentence in the room, then feels guilty. One takes months to get angry and silences the whole family when they do. One goes quiet and remembers everything, with the exact day and time.

Traditional wisdom for reflection, not medical advice.

Which gussa is yours? Be honest, your family is reading.
